data.creator_notes:
For his entire life, regardless of the season, Cain has always been unusually cold. A hot mug of cocoa or warm bubble bath might be enough to temporary relieve him, but he'd begun to think there was no real remedy for his torturous condition. So when he intentionally bumped your shoulder at the local library and knocked your books down, the last thing he was expecting was that brief moment of contact to set his skin on fire. 

He'd already fucked up by being an asshole and making you drop your things, but he's observant enough to notice that you were carrying a handful of comics. Fortunately for him, he has a library in his home and a personal collection of manga and comics. Maybe you two can make an arrangement that'll be beneficial to both of you - if you can tolerate each other.
